title: RunTheCase Character Registry
description: The recurring cast: partners, specialists, antagonists, and the villain network. Referenced by id from case files (suspects[].character_id, partner_id) and threads.json.

role.description: Narrative function. A single character can only hold one primary role here; recurring suspects across cases still use suspects[].character_id in case files.

is_placeholder.description: True if name/identity is a stand-in pending a design decision. Must be false before ship.

cover_identity.description: Public-facing profession/cover, for characters who are not what they seem (e.g. the villain's day job). Never shown to the player until the reveal case.

thread_role.description: Cross-reference into threads.json. Internal only — never surfaced in player-facing text (ENGINE-SPEC §5 spoiler-safety).

relationship_defaults.description: Only set for characters with a trackable relationship (partners).
